what: decomp-permuter on osCreateThread (0x80006d60, boot image, 52 words) with the image as the objective

settings.objective: target.o built by make_target.py from the boot image's 52 words

verdict: NEGATIVE, and the boundary is the finding. Nothing reaches 52. The two candidates that beat the base by words (26/52, 25/52) emit 56 instructions -- four too many -- and are WORSE content-aligned (39, 38 against the base's 41), so no candidate is a real improvement. Unlike p6, whose residue was a statement order the randomiser can reach, this residue is parameter-load scheduling and register allocation, which the permuter's move set does not touch. The permuter is a SHAPE search; allocation is still hand work.
